action_interface.construction_rule: Copy the frozen original request byte-identically except for inserting exactly one subject Attribute (Category access-subject, AttributeId urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:2.0:conformance-test:some-attribute, DataType xsd:string) carrying the world-specific value. No authorization logic is performed by the wrapper.

target_semantics.rule: Use the canonical XACML Decision returned by the frozen PDP on each complete request world. No expected per-world outcome is stated here; outcomes enter only via parsed PDP responses in the Phase-2 target audit.
